notes: THE ADVANCE IS COMPLETE. Contract value QAR 150,000.00. The 50% advance of QAR 75,000.00 is now received IN FULL. Balance QAR 75,000.00 — 30% QAR 45,000.00 after installation of the sandwich panel, 10% QAR 15,000.00 during the works, and 10% QAR 15,000.00 final.

THE SIX PAYMENTS MAKING UP THE ADVANCE, ALL BY QNB TRANSFER FROM YOUR ACCOUNT 0250-068740-001 AND ALL SHOWN ON YOUR ADVICES AS SUCCESS: QAR 10,000.00 under IB1A11385427 of 05-11-2026 and QAR 10,000.00 under IB1A11386998 of 06-11-2026, receipted under RCT-302/2026; QAR 10,000.00 under IB1A11621611 of 07-11-2026, receipted under RCT-303/2026; QAR 10,000.00 under IB1A11830077 of 08-11-2026, receipted under RCT-304/2026; QAR 20,000.00 under IB1A13304803 of 14-11-2026, receipted under RCT-306/2026; and QAR 15,000.00 under IB1A13959479 of 17-11-2026, receipted by this receipt. TOTAL QAR 75,000.00.

AGREED PAYMENT SCHEDULE. 50% advance QAR 75,000.00 — now settled; 30% QAR 45,000.00 after installation of the sandwich panel; 10% QAR 15,000.00 during the works; and 10% QAR 15,000.00 final. This schedule is as agreed between us and replaces the terms printed at clause 12 of our quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ144/2026.

THE MATERIAL ORDERS NOW GO FORWARD. With the advance complete we are placing the orders for the 636.00 sqm of 100 mm panel and for the refrigeration equipment — the condensing unit and the unit cooler — and we shall write to you with the production and delivery dates for both. Under our quotation the material delivery runs 7 to 10 days from the approved advance payment, and the programme runs from today.
THE NEXT STAGE. The 30% of QAR 45,000.00 falls due once the sandwich panel is installed. We shall notify you in writing on the day the panel work is complete.

Our thanks for settling the advance in full. Kindly quote invoice INV-301/2026 as the reference on future payments. This receipt is issued against INV-301/2026 and is subject to the terms of our approved quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ144/2026, as varied by the agreed payment schedule above.
